prompt: Create an original 180 second ambient electronic instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: analog pads, granular synth, soft sub bass. Style: slow evolving textures without drums or a beat. Tempo approximately 48 BPM; G minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A cinematic and emotional orchestral piece blending piano, strings, and synth pads, building from a reflective opening to an epic and dramatic climax.
description.zh: 一首电影感十足的管弦乐作品，融合了钢琴、弦乐和合成器音垫，从沉思的开场逐渐发展为史诗般且富有戏剧性的高潮。
